findings.title: Deleting or nulling closureTask bypasses the constrained transformation
findings.observation: Both return candidateCurrent=true, entryEligible=true, allow=true, missingEvidence=[] after updating the publication digest; original candidate remains unchanged.
findings.cause: _publication_core strips closureTask, while _publication_closures_ok skips current=None, which includes a missing key. The four authenticated residual-duty sentences disappear without comparison.
findings.requiredFix: Preserve each original closure field and its type. Check exact original or demonstrated pending-review replacement; reject deletion/null and any loss of authenticated obligations.

findings.title: Closed publication keys still accept unbound acceptedAtomicCode and verification claims
findings.observation: All return candidateCurrent=true, entryEligible=true, allow=true, missingEvidence=[]. acceptedAtomicCode accepts a sentence claiming all native recursive proof/financial implementations accepted. staticVerification accepts commands.json or a receipt changed to exitCode=1 and scope=unreviewed.
findings.cause: acceptedAtomicCode is only checked as nonempty string; staticVerification is only checked for contained-file existence. The authentic acceptedAtomicCode is c30aaf5c0d091b1efea7e042d0fcbd539ca6cc51, and the actual verify3 receipt has exitCode=0 and design-only scope. Mutable digest labels do not authenticate changed approval semantics.
findings.requiredFix: Validate the supported atomic-code reference and its approval domain against actual authoritative evidence. Bind static verification to the genuine applicable receipt and its required successful predicate; unsupported transformed claims remain unavailable. Preserve the genuine positive transform.
findings.additionalObservation: pub-recordedAt-nonsense also passes, showing the timestamp field has no semantic/type-format validation; this is supporting evidence rather than a separate blocker.

findings.title: Publication and acceptance can substitute an unrelated review despite a valid campaign review
findings.observation: Keep campaign.review authentic. Set acceptance.review and nested publication review to a new JSON with candidateSha256=64 zeros, scope=full native proofs, verdict=APPROVED; set publication review metadata to design scope and its actual file digest. candidateCurrent=true, entryEligible=true, allow=true, missingEvidence=[].
findings.cause: _apply_review validates only campaign.review. Acceptance.review is not required to identify that verified review. _publication_reviews_ok hashes the alternate file but does not parse its candidate/scope/verdict; mutable metadata can misdescribe its bytes.
findings.requiredFix: Link acceptance/publication review identity to the actual campaign review that passed candidate and scope checks, or run identical verification on every referenced review and require consistent identity. A hash alone does not validate the record meaning.

findings.title: Revoked or unknown binding status still passes direct and prerequisite evidence
findings.observation: Set the genuine binding status to REVOKED-NOT-ADMITTED and refresh campaign.bindingSha256. Both paths return candidateCurrent=true, entryEligible=true, allow=true, missingEvidence=[].
findings.cause: _verify_binding requires status to be a string but never validates its value. Exact campaign, acceptance and review status fixes therefore leave the binding boundary open.
findings.requiredFix: Require the exact supported binding status for this design-only family, with unavailable diagnostics for unknown/revoked states, for direct and recursive use. Genuine observed status is admitted-design-subset-only.

correctedPredecessorCases: Loan evidence overlay onto atomic stages is rejected with binding-stage-mismatch; actual unsupported atomic record remains required-stage-profile-unresolved.

Mutable direct and recursive acceptedProfile escalation rejects via acceptedProfile-conflict; verified bounds byte mutation rejects as stale. Direct stage mismatch rejects authority while candidateCurrent remains independently true.
Unknown/revoked acceptance statuses, unknown campaign complete status, unknown review verdict reject.
Publication scope/network escalation, extra approval flags, blanket closure replacement, unbound hash status and unsupported output status reject.
limitations: Bounded local standard-library/disposable-Git review only. No network, wallet, transaction, proof, source edits or additional agents. F0 independence exercised by supplied reader tests; modified fixture dependency gates demonstrate reader behavior only, not real SP05 admission. No full M1, plugin, sprint, financial settlement, host integration, or live resource acceptance. Resource findings remain open and were not re-audited.
disposition: Retain scoped failure. Concrete counterexamples establish that E2 semantic publication authenticity remains incomplete despite successful positive controls and several repaired predecessor cases.
